reason: Snowflake's per-query overhead dominates TPC-H at these scales. Per-query means sit between 0.75 and 1.8 s at every scale factor (geometric mean 951 ms at SF 0.1, 1003 ms at SF 1, 1272 ms at SF 10, x1.35 over a 100x increase in LINEITEM from 600,572 to 59,986,052 rows).
